methods.label: Triangle angle sum
methods.explanation: \(\angle C=180^\circ-50^\circ-60^\circ=70^\circ\). The three pairs of corresponding angles are equal, so \(\angle F=\angle C=70^\circ\). This also shows that when two pairs of corresponding angles are equal, the third pair is equal as well, so ASA and AAS can be derived from each other.
methods.levelReason: The solution uses the triangle angle sum and elementary subtraction.
